verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents several user-configured background processes. SQL alert rules run on a set interval and fire Slack or HTTP webhook destinations (docs-21, docs-22). Refreshable materialized views recompute data on their own (docs-34). Large SQL operations run as retryable background batch jobs with pause, retry and cancel controls (docs-15). Its agent features (MCP, CHKit, branches) are driven interactively or from CI rather than as autonomous scheduled agents. missing for 10: a general-purpose scheduler or workflow automation, autonomous agent-triggered automations, in-depth docs on configuring scheduled jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
